2. Craft 4 jungle planks using this jungle log.

6. Craft 1 torch using 1 stick and 1 coal.

3. Craft 4 stick using 2 oak planks (using the oak log from step 3).
4. Craft 1 torch using 1 stick and 1 coal.
5. Gather 1 coal.
6. Craft 1 torch using 1 stick and 1 coal.

This way, we can craft two torches.
